context: Compare becomes the comparison renderer only; candidate picking lives in the paged Query table. Retire the candidate table only when every parity case passes: empty ?ids=, one id, two ids, four ids, stale id, duplicate id, all-excluded set, reload, copied shared link, and the Pages 404 restore round trip.
description:
/results/compare renders all 207 candidates in a single document 17,441px tall, with no pagination, no search, no sortable headers and no platform filter (it does filter benchmark, scale and phase at Compare.tsx:982-1022). Its action bar renders once above the table and does not stick, so choosing a second run near the bottom leaves the action roughly 16,000px away.

Retirement is the last step, not the first, and only behind a parity gate.

anti_patterns.dont: Remove the candidate table before Query owns candidate picking
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD land the picking surface first
anti_patterns.why: D4 in rx-ux-00 keeps Compare as the comparison renderer only once picking has a home, and rx-ux-27 is what gives Query a durable selected-run list

anti_patterns.dont: assert a paging or scale improvement using the default browser fixture
anti_patterns.instead: gate the claim on the purpose-built larger fixture (rx-ux-13)
anti_patterns.why: the standard fixture is 11 results and cannot exercise large-corpus behaviour

anti_patterns.instead: keep ?ids=<one> pinning that run and opening selection for the second
anti_patterns.why: ResultDetail's 'Compare this result' depends on it

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: regenerate the public-site visual baseline inside the PR
anti_patterns.instead: name which e2e/captures specs the change invalidates and update those deliberately
anti_patterns.why: the baseline is an external CI artifact tied to a base SHA, not a checked-in snapshot

anti_patterns.dont: retire the table before every parity case passes
anti_patterns.why: single-ID pinning and stale-ID recovery are live contracts with e2e coverage

preserves.behavior: /results/compare?ids=<one> pins that run and opens the builder (Compare.tsx:184+); ?ids=<a,b> renders a comparison. Both are live contracts (ResultDetail.tsx:266, e2e/routes/compare.spec.ts:58, compare-entrypoints.spec.ts:76).
Compare's async recovery messaging distinguishing removal from transient failure
Compare's recovery rule that a multi-selection URL stays multi after a one-result recovery, so it does not collapse into the single-result builder (Compare.tsx:331-350).
docs/operations/results-explorer-qa.md S6 workflow sections, updated in the same PR

prior_art.concept: builder status line and intro card that rx-ux-26 rewords before this item removes the table
